title: Levels feature cards
description: A cool-grey section: a big left-aligned heading, three tall white cards with hairline borders and 10px corners (a 4:3 media frame on top, then a title, grey paragraph and green-dotted list), six smaller white cards with a pale green icon tile, title and short text in a 3×2 grid, and a centred green arrow link. The card media zooms slightly on hover.
notes: each big card's media fills a 4:3 frame like object-fit: cover; empty, a dark app-screen placeholder stands in
